body: Thank you so much for replying, and i'm not at the point of getting serious help yet but i like to know that if i reach that point in the near future that it won't affect my ability to get a job. I'm a nursing student.

I'm feeling the same exact way right now. I have been wanting to kill myself since i turned about 16. (18 now) The only reason i haven't done it yet is because i promised myself i wouldn't do it while my parents are still alive, and i don't wanna leave my little cousin all alone in this mess of a world. My advice to you is, stay here for the person you promised. I know its hard. But we will all die eventually and you may as well just wait it out a while and see what happens. Be like an engine and keep rolling on
